justification: Inspected `core/src/main/resources/examples/MegamorphicBypass.java` and the similar `core/src/main/resources/examples/PolymorphismTest.java`. In `MegamorphicBypass.java:9`, `Quarter` is a nested class with a single responsibility and a single method (`deposit()`), no fields, no branching, and no additional behavior; it is just one of three tiny coin implementations used by the enclosing example. That structure does not indicate insufficient modularization for `Quarter` itself.
